ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on peeling fruit according to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expressed dislike for 'taqshir' (peeling fruit), a practice often interpreted by Shia scholars as removing the skin entirely or peeling in a manner that wastes the edible part or lacks etiquette. This ruling highlights the broader Islamic principle of avoiding israf (wastefulness) and maintaining adab (manners) during consumption, reflecting the practical wisdom of the Ahl al-Bayt in daily life.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> him<sup>asws</sup>
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, disliked the peeling of fruits.’”
